notes: Built from kaylousberg.com/game-assets and each pack page (18 requests, 2 s apart); the GitHub links from the KayKit-Game-Assets org via the GitHub API. Every pack page says: "Free for personal and commercial use, no attribution required. (CC0 Licensed)". The paid "Complete KayKit Collection" bundle is left out.
zip_layout: GitHub zips (checked on City Builder Bits): <repo>-main/addons/kaykit_<pack>/Assets/{gltf,fbx,fbx(unity),obj,texture}/ plus LICENSE.txt. The gltf folder holds .gltf + .bin pairs that point at one shared gradient atlas texture (1024x1024 png): keep the folders together or pack each model to .glb with gltf-transform. The addons/ layout is a Godot add-on; ignore it for three.js.
